optimizer.title: Team Optimizer

history.note: The last 20 finished, stopped or failed runs are kept in this browser.
history.confirmClear: Clear all optimizer history? This cannot be undone.
history.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable; history cannot be read.

optimizer.searchMethodHint: Bayesian optimization models all selected thresholds together and can change several at once, so it finds combinations that only help when changed together. Coordinate search moves one threshold at a time.
optimizer.reuseSamplesHint: Exploration uses a fixed seed set, so configurations already simulated for this team, dungeon and settings are read from browser storage instead of being simulated again. Final validation always uses fresh seeds.
optimizer.scanEstimate: {{thresholds}} condition(s): exploration upper budget about {{evaluations}} evaluations / {{runs}} dungeon attempts; final holdout validation is additional.
optimizer.scanEstimateBayes: {{thresholds}} condition(s): suggested exploration budget about {{evaluations}} evaluations / {{runs}} dungeon attempts; more budget improves the chance of finding joint combinations; final holdout validation is additional.
optimizer.memoryEstimate: Roughly {{memory}} in parallel: each worker peaks near {{perWorker}}, and too many will crash the page out of memory.
optimizer.autoRangeHint: Leave either bound blank for model-guided exploration. Step sets the final resolution.
optimizer.searchCountHint: Exploration attempts per seed, capped at the full count above. The winner is validated at full count on independent seeds; cheap exploration can miss small gains.
optimizer.alternativeLoaded: Alternative loaded into the draft. Search ranking is not independent validation; use Start Simulation to check it.
optimizer.holdoutNote: These results use independent holdout seeds and the full attempt count. Curves and alternative rankings below use exploration samples only.
optimizer.boundaryHit: Winning value {{value}} is on the search boundary. Manual bounds can be expanded; beyond automatic support, conditions are usually already constant. This is not proof of a global optimum.

searchStop.running: Exploring; completed evaluation records can be exported.
searchStop.budget: Evaluation budget reached before all regions were refined; convergence is not established.
searchStop.resolution: Selected regions have been refined to the requested step; other peaks and a better global solution may exist.
searchStop.bayesBudget: Evaluation budget used. Bayesian optimization has no convergence point: the choice is the measured configuration the model rates best; rely on the final holdout validation for the gain.
searchStop.bayesExhausted: All grid candidates near the best point have been measured, so the search ended early; rely on the final holdout validation for the gain.
searchStop.stopped: Stopped; completed evaluations and curves have been retained.
searchStop.error: Failed; evaluations completed before the error have been retained.

analysis.title: Threshold search analysis
analysis.caveat: Each curve fixes all other thresholds. Sampled points do not prove a continuous response or exclude unsampled peaks. ΔDPS uses the search starting team as baseline. Search intervals are exploratory, not independent validation or proof of convergence.
analysis.chartHelp: Whiskers show paired 95% intervals. Dashed lines connect sampled points only within one fixed context. Axis scales are shared across contexts of this variable. Hover or focus a point for details.
analysis.noPoints: No finite sampled points in this context.
analysis.modelCaveat: This Gaussian-process curve estimates ΔDPS through the selected configuration with all other thresholds fixed. The shaded 95% band represents model uncertainty, not measurements; only overlaid points are measured. Unexplored regions have wider bands. Use this view to judge peak locations and multiple modes, not as validation.
analysis.modelChart: Gaussian-process threshold slice with model uncertainty and measured paired intervals
analysis.modelHelp: The solid line is the model mean; shading is mean ± 1.96 standard deviations. Overlaid points and their paired 95% intervals are measured configurations with exactly these fixed thresholds. The diamond marks the selected best threshold. Focus, hover, or select a point for exact values.
analysis.noModelSlice: No finite model slice is available for this variable.
analysis.posteriorEstimate: Model estimate ΔDPS: {{mean}}; model standard deviation: {{sd}}
analysis.sensitivityHelp: Relative influence estimated from the Gaussian-process length scales, not a measurement. Only meaningful after enough evaluations.
analysis.sensitivityLow: The model rates this threshold as barely influential; consider unticking it next run to spend the budget on the others.
analysis.partialHelp: Hollow, smaller points have only some paired seed samples; their intervals are based on fewer samples and may be wider.
analysis.point: Value: {{value}}; ΔDPS: {{delta}}; 95% CI: {{interval}}; samples: {{samples}}; evaluation: {{id}}; configuration: {{config}}
analysis.searchOnly: Ranked by mean search DPS. Search samples were reused; these alternatives have not been independently validated.
analysis.historyHelp: Configuration IDs are exact vectors in the variable order below. Includes baseline and every new evaluation; cached configurations can appear in multiple curve contexts without re-running. Numeric cells retain recorded precision.

optimizer.sharedTriggers: Slots with the same ability on the same player share their triggers.
optimizer.unchanged: The draft is unchanged from the original configuration.
optimizer.scanTruncated: Auto-tuning stopped at the maximum number of evaluations.

status.resumed: Resumed the unfinished run; completed seed results are read from storage

result.efficiency: Team DPS gain per million coins
result.draftChanges: Changes already included in the draft (not added by this candidate)
result.draftComparisonNote: The draft is the starting point for this candidate, not the DPS comparison baseline. The baseline remains the original team, so the DPS change includes the effects of both the draft changes and this candidate's own changes. Costs are also calculated from the original team to the final team.
result.efficiencyUnknownPrice: Unknown prices prevent calculating cost efficiency.
result.efficiencyNoDpsGain: No DPS gain; cost efficiency is not calculated.
result.efficiencyNetRecovery: Net cost is negative: selling the old equipment recovers coins overall, so efficiency per coin invested does not apply.
result.efficiencyZeroCost: Net cost is zero: no additional coins are needed, so gain per million coins is not calculated.

errors.rosterChanged: The roster changed; run the simulation again.
errors.noTeam: Select at least one player first.
errors.invalidTriggers: Complete all triggers and enter valid values.
errors.noVariables: Tick at least one condition to auto-tune.
errors.noCandidate: Add or select a candidate first.
errors.rosterMismatch: This report's players are not in the current roster, so it cannot be loaded.
errors.invalidSettings: Enter valid positive integer settings and valid threshold ranges.
